visualCharacteristics: A stack of value-proposition rows on a light background, each pairing a drop-shadow image on one side with text on the other; consecutive rows alternate the image side (Z-pattern). Text side has an icon eyebrow, a heading, and a tagged/bulleted description list.
contentPattern: One row per value prop. Each row has two cells: an image-only cell and a text cell (icon/eyebrow, heading, bullet list). Rows alternate image alignment automatically.
